LABEL: POST-HOC — DIAGNOSTIC ONLY, CHANGES NOTHING

near_collapse_arms.rule: post-hoc: N_X_mean below half the typical value at that L

READING: the frozen estimator aggregates arms by the MEAN of the logs, which a heavy right tail moves. Three arms — one at L=72 and two at L=96 — kept a population five to twenty times below typical without going extinct before the end of the window. With so few molecules the Frechet centre is a noisy estimate of the cloud's position and drifts far from the organiser, so a POPULATION effect enters a SPATIAL statistic through the finite-sample noise of the centre. The across-arm MEDIAN of the same summaries is 3.00, 3.08, 3.00 at L = 36, 72, 96 — flat — and the slope computed from it is -0.01975. Removing the three arms post hoc gives beta = +0.04143. NEITHER of these is the frozen result and NEITHER is used: they say where the frozen number comes from.
DEFECT_RECORDED: the frozen definition of an ANALYSABLE arm — a finite positive summary — admits an arm whose population has partly collapsed. A pre-registered floor on the in-window population would have separated 'the cloud exists' from 'the cloud is measurable'. This is a design defect of OBDI02 and it is recorded, not applied.
